Amit — perfect, we’re locked for Tue May 12 at 15:00 PT (30–45 min). Calendar invite shortly.

Quick answers to procurement asks (summary):
- Retention & audit logs: Redwood private deployments support configurable retention windows; standard offering is 90 days for runtime logs with export to S3/GCS and an optional 12-month audit-export add-on (we'll surface exact retention language in the SOW).
- Audit exports: yes — we provide structured export (JSON/CSV) of request/response metadata plus token cost breakdown. We’ll include an example export schema in the SOW appendix.
- SLA: Vanessa will share our p95 latency targets and fallback behavior by EOD May 14.

Attachments: I’ve attached an updated SOW with a marked section for retention + audit-export options (Atlas_SOW_v2.pdf, updated for procurement). Ben will share the internal slide for procurement review by EOD May 11.

1) Marissa — finalize SOW with legal markups (target May 18)
